author_source_evidence.copy_policy: Do not copy author app implementation into RTDL core. Use source as behavioral evidence and implement generic RTDL APIs with independent tests.

author_evidence: src/loaders/ply_loader.h loads PLY vertices and subtracts per-input vmin
phases.rtdl_current: App-owned PLY bridge supports explicit translate_each_input_to_min_bound and matches author on sample256/1024/2048.
phases.next: Keep as app-owned input contract; do not promote to RTDL core unless needed by multiple apps.

author_evidence: hausdorff_distance_rt.h computes HDLowerBound and HDUpperBound from input MBRs
phases.rtdl_current: No public generic HD bound API exposed.
phases.next: Add generic MBR distance bound helper for point sets / bounding boxes.

author_evidence: uniform_grid.h implements grid resolution, cell encoding, point insertion, prefix sums, tight cell MBRs
phases.rtdl_current: No generic public device uniform-grid point index with tight-cell MBR output for partner routes.
phases.next: Design app-neutral PointGridIndex2D/3D or cell-MBR descriptor API.

author_evidence: hausdorff_distance_rt.h builds/updates OptiX BVH over grid cell MBRs expanded by radius
primitive_utils.h maps MBR + radius to OptixAabb
phases.rtdl_current: RTDL has RT primitives, but not a public generic cell-MBR radius traversal primitive for nearest-cell search.
phases.next: Expose generic radius-expanded MBR candidate traversal over cell descriptors, not an X-HD primitive.

author_evidence: shaders_nn_uniform_grid.cu maintains cmin2 in OptiX payload
shader prunes cells using min distance to cell MBR and current cmin2
shader updates cmax2 / miss queue / status
phases.rtdl_current: Current RTDL X-HD route is exact pairwise reference after traversal, not in-traversal nearest-state search.
phases.next: Define generic nearest-with-bounds traversal contract: per-query state cmin, global bound cmax, prune predicate, and miss frontier.

author_evidence: shaders_nn_uniform_grid.cu checks min_dist2 > radius^2, min_dist2 >= cmin2, max_dist2 <= cmax2, and early-break distance <= cmax2
phases.rtdl_current: No public generic in-traversal early-break nearest reducer.
phases.next: Implement as dataflow pushdown/reducer API if it can stay app-neutral.

author_evidence: hausdorff_distance_rt.h identifies large cells by processing_threshold
loadBalanceProcessing handles heavy cells in CUDA
phases.rtdl_current: No generic heavy-cell offload queue API tied to RT traversal output.
phases.next: Design generic continuation queue: (query_id, cell_id) -> partner exact processing.

author_evidence: hausdorff_distance_rt.h iterates miss queue and grows radius by adaptive/double/add policies
BVH is updated or rebuilt after radius changes
phases.rtdl_current: No generic iterative frontier controller for radius-expanded spatial search.
phases.next: Expose loop contract around frontier, radius policy, and rebuild/update strategy.

author_evidence: run_hausdorff_distance.cu writes HDResult, Running.AvgTime, Repeats, Iterations
hausdorff_distance_rt.h records RTTime, CUDATime, OffloadingSize, Radius, CMax2, Memory
phases.rtdl_current: Paper app keeps phase fields separated, but no unified RTDL X-HD-style metrics schema exists.
phases.next: If implementing scalable route, expose app-neutral phase counters and memory accounting.

decision.recommended_next_goal: Goal5138 generic grid-cell candidate API design
do_not_continue: Do not push exact pairwise route to full resolution.
Do not add an XHD-named primitive to RTDL core.
Do not claim Figure 5 performance until generic algorithmic route exists and denominators align.
